rationale: The whitepaper explicitly details the contents of a Verification Query Package (VQP), listing all five required elements: the code unit, parent requirements, test artifacts, datasheets/specifications, and version-matched physical test evidence. It also clearly outlines the rationale that the context window is the design primitive and queries must be bounded to prevent truncation.
